visible.title: HMI continuum intensity near the Fe I 6173 Å line (617.3 nm)
visible.sourceFormat: 4096 x 4096 single-component 8-bit grayscale JPEG2000. FITS record says CONTINUUM INTENSITY and HMI_FRONT2.
visible.processing: Full grayscale continuum intensity map kept in neutral grayscale. Original limb darkening and measured sunspots retained. Full frame encoded as WebP; the lite file is a 1024-pixel Lanczos reduction. No local tone or detail adjustments.
visible.note: The companion colorized HMIIC quick-look product uses a different image scale and is not used as the neutral texture.

euv.title: AIA 171 Å (17.1 nm) extreme ultraviolet, predominantly Fe IX
euv.sourceFormat: 4096 x 4096 NASA SDO JPEG, standard gold EUV color mapping.
euv.processing: The full original field, off-limb loops and supplied gold display mapping are retained. Converted to WebP, also reduced to 1024 pixels with Lanczos.
euv.captionNote: Bottom-left archive timestamp remains in the original texture margin. Outside this narrow rectangle measured coronal light continues to the edges.

registration.origin: UV measured from top-left image edge. Solar north is upward. Solar west is toward the right.
registration.note: Both instruments share reference WCS geometry. HMI has a distinct photospheric limb; measured first edge at 1583.83 px. EUV median brightness peaks at 1598 px in an annulus and real coronal structure extends substantially farther with no single outer rim.

activeRegion.method: Connected components above a local 36% continuum intensity deficit within the southwestern group. Corresponding positions were visually checked against the co-aligned EUV loops.
